description: The name now says exactly what the fixture pins: `tell`/`ask`/`each` are reserved WITHOUT the Sprites profile. All three `define`s raise `ol-reserved-word` under `core-language` alone, because `spec/grammar.md:408` makes profile words built-in names unconditionally -- what a profile decides is whether a name WORKS, never whether a program may declare it -- and issue #855 aligned `spec/turtles-and-sprites.md:154` with that ruling. HISTORY: issue #679 (SP7) wrote this as the OFF half of a profile gate, expecting all three to check clean until a program opted into Sprites; ruling #833 retracted the gate and issue #841 removed it from the checker, so the expectation is flipped here rather than the fixture deleted -- the behaviour stays pinned across the reversal, and the reversal stays visible in one file's history. `"check": true`: it asserts the checker diagnostics, not execution -- the procedures are never called and no events are produced.
